title: "Equipment from a WS-461L balloon on display in Moscow, 11 October 1958"
description: Black-and-white photograph of a crowd of people examining recovered balloon equipment shown at an exhibit hall. Captioned "Equipment from a WS-461L balloon on display in Moscow, 11 October 1958." The text quotes Eisenhower ordering the balloon project discontinued and describes the September 1958 shootdown of an Air Force EC-130 over Soviet Armenia (Chapter 3, p. 146).
